identity.description:
Run pr-review in CI on every pull request

## Summary

Each pull request in this repo now gets an automated review from pr-review. The review runs when a PR opens, gets a push, reopens or becomes ready. A maintainer can also start it with a `review:` label or the comment `@pr-review full`. It posts one review comment and one neutral check run. It does not block a merge. A draft PR gets no review until it is marked ready.

**Ticket:** N/A
**Type:** New feature

---

## Agent context

### Authority

The "Set up CI" section of the `jerridan/pr-review` README owns this setup. No `docs/design.md` section or crew reference governs it.

### What changed, by file

- `.github/workflows/pr-review.yml` — new. It is the consumer workflow from the pr-review README, word for word. It calls `jerridan/pr-review/.github/workflows/review.yml@v1` with `secrets: inherit`.
- `.pr-review/config.yaml` — new. It sets `skip.draft: true`, so the run skips a draft PR. The `ready_for_review` event then starts the review.

### Constraints that applied

- Version bump: none. The file is not under `agents/`, `skills/`, `hooks/` or the manifests, so it does not reach a plugin user.
- Secret: the repo secret `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` exists (set 2026-10-15).
- Access: this repo is public, so it can call only a public workflow. `jerridan/pr-review` is now public.
- Release tag: the tag `v1` exists on `jerridan/pr-review`.

### How this was verified

I checked the secret with `gh secret list`, the access setting with `gh api /repos/jerridan/pr-review/actions/permissions/access`, and the tag with `gh api repos/jerridan/pr-review/git/refs/tags/v1`. This PR is the first run of the workflow. Its result shows on this PR.

### Known gaps

- `pull_request_target` and `issue_comment` events read the workflow from the default branch. The label and comment triggers work only after this PR merges.
- pr-review reads `.pr-review/config.yaml` from the base branch. The draft skip starts to work only after this PR merges, so this draft PR still gets a review.
- The records branch `pr-review-records` does not exist yet. The first run creates it.
